entries.title: Titus 1:1
segments: To Titus, my true son in a common faith, from Paul, a slave of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and to the knowledge of the truth which goes with piety;

entries.title: Titus 1:2
segments: I write in hope of life eternal which God who never lies, promised before times eternal,

entries.title: Titus 1:3
segments: but manifested in his own time; that word of his in proclaiming which I have been entrusted by command of God our Saviour.

entries.title: Titus 1:4
segments: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.

entries.title: Titus 1:5
segments: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you might set right the things left unfinished, and appoint presbyters in every city as I had instructed you;

entries.title: Titus 1:6
segments: men who are blameless, the husband of one wife, with believing children who are not accused of riot or insubordination.

entries.title: Titus 1:7
segments: For indeed a presiding officer, as God's steward, ought to be blameless, not self-willed or quick-tempered, not a drunkard or violent, or greedy of filthy lucre;

entries.title: Titus 1:8
segments: but he must be hospitable, a lover of the good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled.

entries.title: Titus 1:9
segments: He must hold to the faithful word according to the teaching, so that he may be able both to encourage by sound teaching, and to confute our opponents.

entries.title: Titus 1:10
segments: For there are many individuals who are unruly, empty talkers and deceivers, particularly those of the circumcision, whose mouths must be stopped;

entries.title: Titus 1:11
segments: for they upset whole households and, for filthy lucre's sake, teach what they ought not to teach.

entries.title: Titus 1:12
segments: By one of their own number, by a prophet of their own, it has been said, "Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons."

entries.title: Titus 1:13
segments: This testimony is true. So rebuke them sharply,

entries.title: Titus 1:14
segments: so as to make them sound in the faith, not giving heed to Jewish myths and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

entries.title: Titus 1:15
segments: All things are pure to the pure; but to the contaminated and the faithless nothing is pure, nay, their very minds and consciences are tainted.

entries.title: Titus 1:16
segments: They profess to know God, but by their deeds they disown him; in that they are detestable, disobedient, and reprobate for good work of any sort.
